posts.body: One system rounded up, the other rounded down. Finance does not do "close enough." I now have permanent trust issues with decimals.
posts.title: "A $0.03 discrepancy once took down my entire reconciliation pipeline."

posts.body: 40% nulls in a required field. Dates in four formats. Agents optimize for finishing, not for being right, so now a human does the trusting.
posts.title: "The AI agent told me the data was 'clean enough.' It was not clean enough."

posts.body: $150 a day down to under $40. The savings hid in the boring stuff: caching, dedupe, killing zombie cron jobs. The invoice does not care how clever your agent is.
posts.title: "We cut our scraping bill by 73%. The AI agent deserves about 20% of the credit."

posts.body: It rebuilt my website, pushed it to GitHub, and fixed the failed deploy itself while I made coffee. Sometimes it's slow. But I didn't have to do it at all.
posts.title: "Day 2 of Muse."
